lawful_availability_contract.rule: For a drift_burst state or completed event emitted while processing source tick i, available_time = received_ts_ns(i); source_sequence(i) is the causal tie-break when received_ts_ns values are equal.
lawful_availability_contract.occurrence_time: The emitted feature event_time_ns is tick.event_time_ns and is retained as the row event_ts_ns; it identifies market/source occurrence time, not availability.
lawful_availability_contract.availability_time: The frozen row received_ts_ns is CanonicalTick.received_time_ns, the source receipt/ingestion timestamp. It is preserved by replay and serialized into the same XAUUSD row.
